items.headline: Tyreek Hill may return to Kansas City
items.description: Nate Taylor on how Tyreek Hill's return timing couldn't be better for a Chiefs team dealing with injuries to Tyquan Thornton and Rashee Rice.

items.headline: Sources: Chiefs WR Tyquan Thornton expected back in 12-16 weeks
items.description: Chiefs wide receiver Tyquan Thornton is expected back from a dislocated left ankle injury within 12 to 16 weeks, sources told NFL Network.

items.headline: Why a Tyreek Hill-Chiefs reunion makes so much sense
items.description: The Chiefs had been monitoring and receiving updates on Hill's rehab and training sessions even before the injuries to Tyquan Thornton and Rashee Rice.

items.headline: Tyreek Hill could sign with new team soon, agent says
items.description: Free agent wide receiver Tyreek Hill could sign with a new team "over the next few days," his agent, Drew Rosenhaus, told ESPN's Adam Schefter. Hill's former team, the Chiefs, are believed to be one of those interested.
